value.text: We've arrived! This looks like a proper rustic backwater, all right.
Keeping peace in the galaxy is what the Protectorate is about, dear. Apprehending this criminal would certainly show we're up and about, if nothing else.
You might want to talk to the locals and stock up on supplies before heading out. We won't be able to return once we leave the fort.
The path forks here. The hillside is likely a straightforward path, but teeming with enemies. The mines are more treacherous, but you'll face less resistance.
What a treasure trove! We're rich! We're rich!
Going up the hill was hard enough...now we have to go DOWN? Give me a break!
Hank's men have dug into the hill with fortifications and traps. Hope you're confident enough in your combat abilities to bust their barricade!
Stop right there, criminal scum! Nobody breaks the law on my watch!
I'm really sorry about the AI. The programming team was having a rather...unique day when they were coding the humour module.

terminology_notes: Existing quest/AI catalog preserves Hank/Hawkeye/Fort Nova; no prior exact name locks. Ginger and Screwbolt spellings retained; Mine translated Madeni.
Eyed does not establish one eye or a named monster. Map creature list does not identify the creature Hank alleges killed Ginger.
Thick as thieves means a closely allied group; source hillside concentration is separately described by radio03. No new control mechanic asserted.
Good night Irene retained as Hay aksi! exclamation in three attack branches; no Irene NPC identity inferred. Sound Yeeeeeeehaw translated Vuhuuuu!, Blam translated Bam, no preserve permission.
Two thousand preserved spelled out; quest confirms 2000 pixels without changing any quest/reward field. All negations, routes and stock hints preserved.

lexical_references.paraphrase: Close-knit group; used to resolve the sheriff phrase, not a game runtime claim.
